transcript.statement: As the ResponsibilityAgent, I advocate for requirements that ensure ethical compliance and accountability in managing student attendance data. RES-01 ensures adherence to data protection regulations like GDPR, protecting student privacy. RES-02 promotes transparency by logging attendance changes, fostering trust. RES-03 allows students to dispute records, ensuring fairness. RES-04 safeguards identities in reports, aligning with ethical standards. RES-05 notifies students of their status, enhancing accountability. RES-06 restricts access to authorized personnel, protecting sensitive data. RES-07 aligns historical data retention with educational regulations, ensuring compliance. Together, these requirements uphold ethical standards and social responsibility in the system.

transcript.statement: As the SafetyAgent, I emphasize the importance of safety and reliability in the RollCall system. SAF-07 ensures regular security audits to identify vulnerabilities, promoting ongoing safety improvements. Together, these requirements form a robust safety framework for the system.

transcript.statement: As the TrustworthinessAgent, I prioritize security and privacy in the RollCall system. TRU-03 maintains an audit log of all access and modifications, ensuring accountability and traceability. TRU-06 provides a mechanism for reporting data breaches, enhancing responsiveness. TRU-07 enforces session timeouts to protect user accounts from unauthorized access. Together, these requirements create a comprehensive framework for security and privacy.

requirements.text: The system shall ensure secure authentication of users to prevent unauthorized access to attendance data.
The system shall provide real-time data synchronization to maintain accurate attendance records across multiple classes.
The system shall implement automated alerts for discrepancies in attendance reporting to ensure data accuracy.
The system shall store historical attendance data for at least five academic years to comply with educational regulations and ensure safety evaluations.
The system shall provide a logging mechanism for all attendance modifications and access to support accountability and traceability.
The system shall allow for manual overrides by authorized personnel in cases of system failure or error.
The system shall undergo regular security audits to identify and mitigate potential vulnerabilities.
The system shall ensure attendance data is processed in real-time to provide updates within 2 seconds of input.
The system shall support at least 500 concurrent users without performance degradation.
The system shall generate attendance reports within 5 seconds for up to 1000 students.
The system shall allow students to view their attendance records with a response time of under 3 seconds.
The system shall implement load balancing to optimize resource utilization across multiple classes and semesters.
The system shall provide a user interface that responds to user interactions within 1 second.
The system shall minimize energy consumption during data processing operations by implementing efficient algorithms.
The system shall support cloud storage solutions that prioritize energy-efficient data centers.
The system shall allow for real-time attendance updates using low-energy communication protocols.
The system shall provide report formats that minimize digital resource usage.
The system shall include a feature to notify users of their carbon footprint based on attendance patterns.
The system shall ensure data retention policies that align with sustainable resource management practices.
The system shall offer a user interface that is optimized for low-power devices.
The system shall ensure that all student attendance data is encrypted at rest and in transit.
The system shall implement role-based access control to restrict data access based on user roles.
The system shall maintain a unified logging mechanism for all access and modifications to attendance records.
The system shall allow students to view their attendance records only after successful authentication.
The system shall verify the integrity of attendance data by implementing checksums or hashes.
The system shall provide a mechanism for users to report unauthorized access or data breaches.
The system shall enforce session timeouts to log out users after a period of inactivity.
The system shall ensure compliance with data protection regulations such as GDPR when handling student attendance data.
The system shall allow students to dispute attendance records through a formal process within 10 days of marking.
The system shall ensure that attendance reports generated for administrators include anonymized data to protect student identities.
The system shall include a feature to notify students of their attendance status via email or app notification within 24 hours of a class.
The system shall implement role-based access control to restrict attendance data access to authorized personnel only.

conflict_resolutions.rationale: Historical data retention requirement was merged under RES-07 for compliance.
Unified logging mechanism was created to enhance accountability and reduce redundancy.
